text_markup: {card:Rototurret}'s first subroutine reads, "Trash 1 installed program." Since {card:Rototurret} is a Corp card, the Corp chooses which installed program to trash. Conversely, {card:Bulwark}'s first subroutine reads, "The Runner trashes 1 installed program." Since the Runner is specified to be carrying out this effect, they choose which of their installed programs to trash.
